programme.desc: Billy (Vince Vaughn) and Nick (Owen Wilson) are salesmen whose careers have been torpedoed by the digital world. Trying to prove they are not obsolete, they defy the odds by talking their way into a coveted internship at Google, along with a battalion of brilliant college students.

programme.title: Krakatoa: East of Java
programme.desc: In 1883, ship captain Hanson plans a shipwreck salvage mission in The Dutch East Indies to retrieve a cargo of pearls but an unexpected volcano eruption and a state-ordered transport of convicts upset his plans.

programme.title: The Baby Proposal
programme.desc: Layla Bennett has it all figured out, her own place, a thriving career and a loving fiancé. She co-hosts morning show Wake Up Chicago! Alongside her charming but sometimes irritating colleague Derek Dray. They have different working styles. She likes to be spontaneous and improvise on air, while he's more of a stick to the script guy. When they're given the bombshell of caring for a baby together, it's their worst nightmare…But as they juggle night feeds and nap times with their hectic lives, they can't deny the growing chemistry. Is this unexpected arrival all they needed to realise they were meant to be?

programme.title: The Charm of Love
programme.desc: Maddie, an art historian, travels around the world to find the Lovers Stone, but when she meets Fitz, her search may lead to a true love of her own.

programme.title: City Lights
programme.desc: With the aid of a wealthy tippler, a dewy-eyed tramp who has fallen in love with a sightless flower girl accumulates money to be able to help her medically.

programme.title: Pop Star
programme.desc: When talented young singer, Roxie Santos, meets music producer, Eddie Marz, he promises her an amazing new lifestyle and a future record deal. All he needs her to do is first lend her voice to a celebrity with no singing talent. However, when things go too far and it looks like she might lose her "voice" forever, she sets off to prove the truth.

programme.title: Runaway Jury
programme.desc: In this suspenseful thriller, a high-priced and ruthless jury "consultant" will stop at nothing to secure a verdict on an explosive trial.

programme.title: Love and Honor
programme.desc: While fighting in Vietnam, Dalton hears his girlfriend has dumped him so decides to fly to get her back. AWOL from the war zone, he has seven days to get back to the US, change his girlfriend's mind and make it back to Vietnam without anyone noticing

programme.title: Labyrinth
programme.desc: Sixteen-year-old Sarah must solve a labyrinth to rescue her baby brother when he is taken by the Goblin King.

programme.title: Noah
programme.desc: Russell Crowe stars as Noah in the timeless story of courage, sacrifice, and hope. This visually stunning, action-adventure is hailed as "one of the most unforgettable Biblical epics ever put on film." *Richard Roeper, Chicago-Sun-Times

programme.title: Amityville 3
programme.desc: A journalist moves into the infamous house, adamant that the horrific tales are nothing but urban legends.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Now that Sam and Marlo's baby girl has arrived, it's clear nothing could have prepared Andy for this moment.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: With the 15 Division restructure looming, Andy and Sam's wedding lets the gang celebrate one last hurrah.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: A high-stakes takedown goes awry upon the revelation that rookie cop Andy McNally has busted one of her own.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: As the other rookies hunt for an escaped convict, Swarek lets Andy in on his past undercover exploits.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: The rookie cops duke it out for a cause at “Fite Nite.”

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Andy trades in her uniform for something more risqué when she goes undercover as a prostitute.

programme.title: I Spit On Your Grave: Deja Vu
programme.desc: Finally, after 1978's I Spit On Your Grave shocked the world with its story of a beautiful career woman assaulted and left for dead, and her notorious revenge on those responsible, cinema's most lethal Lady Vengeance returns in the most anticipated sequel of all time. Reuniting star Camille Keaton and original director Meir Zarchi, I Spit On Your Grave: Deja Vu sends now successful writer Jennifer Hills hurtling back to where it all began - to face the wrath of the families of those she murdered. Kidnapped along with her daughter Christy, it's a tense game of hunt - or be hunted - against a ruthless gang of degenerates and their violently unhinged matriarch, Becky. Hailed as a feminist revenge masterpiece by some, and misunderstood as crude exploitation by others, revenge is about to come full circle in Deja Vu, the final chapter in cinema's most shocking cult franchise.

programme.title: Lady Bloodfight
programme.desc: Jane is a beautiful but troubled American girl backpacking her way through Hong Kong. When she successfully fends off three thugs trying to rob her, it draws the attention of Shu, a Wudang champion, who is impressed by her raw street fighting abilities. Shu recruits Jane and trains her to fight in the vicious, all-female, underground martial arts tournament known as The Kumite.

programme.title: I Know Who Killed Me
programme.desc: An idyllic small town is rocked when Aubrey Fleming (Lindsay Lohan), a bright and promising young college student is abducted and tortured by a sadistic serial killer. When she manages to escape, the traumatised girl who regains consciousness in the hospital insists that her identity is that of Dakota Moss a stripper in a seedy club and that the real Aubrey Fleming is still in mortal danger. A taut and gripping erotic thriller with a captivating riddle at its centre, I Know Who Killed Me explores the dark side of identity, sexuality and obsession.

programme.title: Call of The Wild
programme.desc: Call of The Wild is a modern-day story incorporating elements of Jack London's classic short novel. Whilst Ryann (Ariel Gade) is staying with her Grandpa Bill (Christopher Lloyd) a wild hybrid wolf/dog shows up injured on the back porch one night. Ryann and a local friend believe they can train the magnificent animal to become a sled dog leader but first they must try and persuade Grandpa, who knows the animal will eventually have to return to the wild. Then they must stand up to the local bully who wants to claim the dog as his own.

programme.title: Pledge
programme.desc: Spiked with twisted humour and gruesome shocks. When invited to join an elite fraternity, three freshmen social misfits want to improve their reputations. Soon, they are unexpectedly recruited by a shadowy social club offering them raging parties and VIP social status. The catch? A sadistic initiation ritual that goes from depraved to deadly over the course of 48 booze and blood-soaked hours.

programme.title: Dragon Blade
programme.desc: Inspired by true historical events, this epic action thriller stars martial arts legend Jackie Chan, John Cusack and Adrian Brody. When corrupt Roman leader Tiberius arrives with a giant army to claim the Silk Road, Huo An (Chan), teams up his army with an mysterious elite Legion, led by General Lucius (Cusack), to protect his country. A tale of courage, friendship and honour.

programme.title: Here Awhile
programme.desc: Here Awhile is a heart-wrenching and thought-provoking family drama starring Anna Camp (Pitch Perfect), Steven Strait (The Expanse) and Joe Lo Truglio (Brooklyn Nine Nine, Superbad). Terminally ill Anna returns to Portland, Oregon after fifteen years to reconnect with her long estranged younger brother Michael. She reveals to him the difficult decision she has made.

programme.title: Mythica: The Iron Crown
programme.desc: Good and evil battle it out in the fourth gripping adventure from the fantastical franchise. When daring young wizard Marek steals the final piece of the all-powerful Darkspore she embarks on a desperate quest to deliver the cursed artefact to the gods. But is caught in a death race between a ruthless team of elite mercenaries and a trinity of demons.

programme.title: Loving Vincent
programme.desc: Vincent Willem van Gogh is undoubtedly one of the most famous and influential figures in the history of Western art. Yet during his lifetime Vincent struggled with poverty and depression, dying at only 37 years old.

programme.title: Queen of the Desert
programme.desc: Gertrude Bell, a daughter of wealthy British parents, has no interest in the social life of the London elite. Balls, receptions, and the British aristocracy bring her only boredom.

programme.title: Warrior
programme.desc: The youngest son (Hardy) of an alcoholic former boxer (Nolte) returns home, where he's trained by his father for competition in a mixed martial arts tournament -- a path that puts the fighter on a collision corner with his older brother (Edgerton).

programme.title: Christmas at Holly Lodge
programme.desc: Sophie is the proud owner of the perfect Christmas getaway destination. Will her blossoming relationship with a guest end when she discovers his ulterior motive for staying at Holly Lodge? (2017)

programme.title: If Only We Had Christmas
programme.desc: (2020) Festive romance starring Candace Cameron Bure. When a publicist teams up with a cynical VP to help a charity in need, will a surprise revelation put paid to their promising romance?

programme.title: Christmas Wedding Planner
programme.desc: (2017) Romantic drama with Jocelyn Hudon. A woman is hired to plan her cousin's elaborate wedding and things are going perfectly - until a handsome stranger arrives asking questions about the groom.

programme.title: Deliver By Christmas
programme.desc: (2020) Romance with Alvina August and Eion Bailey. Baker Molly is charmed by town newcomer Josh and a customer she's only met by phone. But do her suitors have more in common than she thinks?

programme.title: Twinkle All The Way
programme.desc: (2019) Festive romance with Sarah Drew. Two single parents find themselves growing closer as they juggle a wedding and a VIP Christmas Eve party, discovering love in unexpected places.

programme.title: A Summer to Remember
programme.desc: Jessica Tucker, a widow and successful doctor, is trying to juggle work and family when she learns she's up for the top job at the hospital.

programme.title: The Rewrite
programme.desc: Once upon a time, screenwriter Keith Michaels was on top of the world. But now, he's divorced, broke and hasn't written a hit film in years. His attitude slowly begins to turn when he meets Holly, a single mum.

programme.title: Not Another Happy Ending
programme.desc: When struggling publisher Tom Duval discovers his only successful author, Jane Lockhart, has writer's block, he knows he has to help.

programme.title: The Wedding Arrangements
programme.desc: When talented botanist Violet needs help preparing flower arrangements for a high-profile wedding, she calls upon Jack, a handsome nature photographer who has taken over responsibility for his grandfather's flower shed.

programme.title: Falling in Love at Christmas
programme.desc: Miranda and Paul, two rivals, meet on a costumed Santa crawl and spend a romantic evening together without learning each other's identities. As their anonymous romance continues online, their businesses merge, forcing them into an unwanted partnership.

programme.title: Christmas Mingle
programme.desc: A 30-something marketing executive with a top-notch career, killer wardrobe, dream apartment and great friends fills out a profile on a dating website hoping to find Mr. Right. However, her attempts at impressing her dream guy ends in disaster.

programme.title: Dognapped: Hound for the Holidays
programme.desc: An assistant of an influencer and a charming vet bond to find a missy puppy before Christmas.

programme.title: Christmas à la Carte
programme.desc: When food correspondent, CARLY, gets a shot at her own show nothing goes as planned. She's sent to Angel Heights to help GRANT, a chef, reopen her family's beloved diner and film it for her television show.

programme.title: Mary 4 Mayor
programme.desc: Running for mayor against her incumbent mayor father, an eighteen-year-old young woman learns valuable life lessons that not only are the building blocks to saving her family, but also the town she lives in.

programme.title: The Baby Proposal
programme.desc: Layla Bennett and Derek Dray are the hosts of Wake Up, Chicago and for the folks at home, their chemistry is undeniable. Derek is incredibly protective about the format of Wakeup, Chicago while Layla is always looking to shake things up. One morning they discover an adorable baby named Poppy left in a basket in Laylas dressing room. The mother passed away and the caretaker is unable to care for Poppy and is convinced that Layla and Derek will make perfect parents.

programme.title: Retreat to Paradise
programme.desc: Ellie tends to the injured and cantankerous Jordan as he heals from a shoulder injury. Though he struggles to learn to use his arm again, his attitude leaves Ellie wanting to leave him in his misery. But as they get to know each other more, Jordan starts to see Ellie is exactly who he wants in his life, and hopes Ellie feels the same way.

programme.title: Off The Menu
programme.desc: An unlikely heir to a Mexican fast-food franchise goes ‘cuisine' hunting for the next culinary big thing he can ‘borrow,' and finds himself in a small, dusty New Mexican town where people come from all over to salivate over the culinary treats of a local female chef.

programme.title: Timeless Love
programme.desc: Megan seems to have the perfect life with a wonderful husband named Thomas and 2 adorable children. Then she finds herself awakening from a coma – and discovers she is not and has never been married. But when she meets Thomas for real, she seizes the chance to help him fall in love with her, again—for the first time.

programme.title: Buried in Barstow
programme.desc: Angie Harmon plays Hazel King, a single mom concealing her past.

programme.title: Death Saved My Life
programme.desc: Jade (Meagan Good) appears perfect but her life is far from idyllic behind doors.

programme.title: Escaping My Stalker
programme.desc: Taylor lived on the streets until she was taken in by Larry and Sandy Stewart.

programme.title: Parents Gone Bad
programme.desc: Stories of mothers and fathers who made headlines by committing crimes.

programme.title: Stranger In My Bed
programme.desc: Sarah leaves her abusive husband by faking her own death.

programme.title: Sweet Autumn
programme.desc: Maggie inherits half of her aunt's maple business and teams up with Dex to uncover the truth behind her will.

programme.title: Killer Reputation
programme.desc: A PR maven takes pride in her reputation, but she risks it to help a star accused of killing his ex-wife.

programme.title: Sisters of the Groom
programme.desc: Jason ropes his neighbor Sarah into pretending to be his girlfriend for his brother's wedding but his prying sisters suspect something is amiss.

programme.title: Forever Love
programme.desc: A couple's lost love goes full circle between the 50's and the present.

programme.title: Daddy Day Camp
programme.desc: DADDY DAY CARE pals Charlie and Phil are back in this hilarious, all-new adventure: DADDY DAY CAMP! When the dads expand their childcare magic to Camp Driftwood - serving up sports, crafts and teaching the kids a thing or two about nature, they discover the camp has everything it needs except a plan to put the bullies of rival Camp Canola to shame. With some quick thinking, teamwork, a secret weapon and some off-the-wall crazy antics, the dads and kids unite to make sure DADDY DAY CAMP secures its rightful place in kid camp history!

programme.title: No Census, No Feeling
programme.desc: The Stooges get jobs as census takers and wind up in a fancy mansion looking for people to survey. Moe and Larry are recruited to join a bridge game, while Curly adds Alum to the lemonade. The resulting concoction is consumed by everyone, resulting in puckered lips and shrunken clothes. The boys next try to take the census at a football stadium. They disguise themselves as players and wind up in the middle of the game. Curly runs off with the ball and all the other players in pursuit.

programme.title: Nutty But Nice
programme.desc: The Stooges are singing waiters who are enlisted by a doctor to try and cheer up a little girl. It seems that the girl's father is a banker who was kidnapped with $300,000 worth of bonds. Failing to cheer up the girl, the Stooges go out looking for the father and by a series of coincidences wind up in the bad guys hideout. The villains return and after a wild fight the boys free the missing man.

programme.title: Did You Hear About The Morgans?
programme.desc: The comedy Did You Hear About the Morgans? follows a highly successful Manhattan couple, Meryl and Paul Morgan (Sarah Jessica Parker and Hugh Grant), whose almost-perfect lives have only one notable failure: their dissolving marriage. But the turmoil of their romantic lives is nothing compared to what they are about to experience: they witness a murder and become targets of a contract killer.

programme.title: America's Sweethearts
programme.desc: When a public romance turns into a private breakup, only a press agent and an assistant can help.

programme.title: Punchline
programme.desc: Stand-up comedy hopefuls toil in obscurity at a New York club while waiting for their big break.

programme.title: Joe Somebody
programme.desc: Tim Allen is Joe, a guy whose life has been steadily changing for the worse. When the office bully goes too far, Joe decides it's time to turn himself from a nobody into a somebody.

programme.title: Gambit
programme.desc: Harry Deane is a man with a plan. Art curator for media tycoon Lord Lionel Shahbandar, Harry devises an elaborate plot to con Shahbandar into purchasing a fake Monet painting.

programme.title: Switched
programme.desc: Tired of being bullied, Cassandra Evans prays that her nemesis, Katie Sharp, the queen bee of social media, would know what it's like to walk a day in her shoes. Her prayer is answered in an unexpected way when they get "Switched."

programme.title: As of Yet
programme.desc: Told entirely through video calls and digital diaries, Naomi navigates a problematic roommate and a burgeoning romance all while locked down during the Coronavirus pandemic.

programme.title: The Shooting
programme.desc: A mysterious woman persuades two cowboys to help her in a revenge scheme.

programme.title: Belle Starr's Daughter
programme.desc: The daughter of famous outlaw Belle Starr arrives at the town where her mother was murdered to find her killer.

programme.title: The Relentless Four
programme.desc: Texas Ranger Sam Garrett sets out to clear Rex Calhoun's name but is betrayed by four ruthless cowboys. Left for dead and later framed for murder, Garrett escapes jail only to find a bounty on his own head. Now hunted by killers and the law, he must fight to survive and uncover the truth.

programme.title: Patience Has a Limit, We Don't
programme.desc: During the Civil War, Corporal MacDonald hides a large gold shipment meant for the Union. Before he can retrieve it, he's killed—taking the secret location with him. Now, a Union lieutenant and MacDonald's two sons compete to uncover the buried treasure in a tense hunt filled with danger and deception.

programme.title: Long Days of Vengeance
programme.desc: After three years of brutal labor for a crime he didn't commit, ex-Sheriff Ted Barnett escapes prison to hunt down the three men who framed him for his father's murder. "Long Days of Vengeance" is a gripping spaghetti western about justice, revenge, and redemption under the scorching desert sun.

programme.title: Beast Must Die
programme.desc: Tom Newcliffe assembles guests at his hunting lodge with the purpose of tracking down a werewolf.

programme.title: Penny and the Pownall Case
programme.desc: An artist's model, with aspirations to be an amateur detective, helps a Scotland Yard detective break a gang.

programme.title: Take My Life
programme.desc: A temperamental opera star finds out her husband is accused of murder she sets off to find the real killer.

programme.title: Behind The Headlines
programme.desc: A journalist investigating a murder is joined by a reporter more interested in catching him than the killer.

programme.title: Black Orchid
programme.desc: A man seeking divorce to marry his wife's sister faces scandal when she suddenly dies.

programme.title: The Embezzler
programme.desc: An elderly bank clerk with only two years to live absconds with the contents of a bank safe.

programme.title: Cross of Voodoo
programme.desc: When two graduate students on the trail of the Haitian Cross of Utu disappear in New Orleans, Sydney and Nigel go down on the bayou to find them.

programme.title: Roman Holiday
programme.desc: Sydney and Nigel are on a trip, so Claudia decides to help Sydney's friend Roger to find Julius Caesar's armor, but relic hunting is not her talent.

programme.title: The Reel Thing
programme.desc: Working as consultants for an archeology adventure film, Sydney and Nigel realize the Pharaoh Amun II's props are genuine, long-thought lost relics. How can they be?

programme.title: Out of the Past
programme.desc: Claudia discovers that she was Cleopatra's servant in a past life when she experiences déjà vu while watching a catalog from an Ancient Egyptian relics exposition.

programme.title: Eyes of Toklamanee
programme.desc: Sydney and her student Adam are onto his ancestors' fabled Eyes of Toklamanee, but they are pursued by mysterious gunmen.

programme.title: Run Sydney Run
programme.desc: Sydney and Nigel are ambushed in Russia. Two weeks later, Sydney wakes up in the house of a man called Tsarlov, who claims to have saved her.

programme.title: M.I.A.
programme.desc: Sydney gets kidnapped, but by whom? Nigel, Claudia and Cate will have to go through the list of enemies Sydney has made in the past and deduce which of them is responsible. Cue flashbacks.

programme.title: Dont Go Into the Woods
programme.desc: Sydney's friend phones to inform her that he's discovered information on the Golden Hawk of Maribor, lost since 1711. Sydney and Nigel travel to Lubjanka to meet him, but he's already gone.

programme.title: All the Names of God
programme.desc: The gripping story of an unsuspecting taxi driver who becomes a pawn in a dangerous game of survival as he is taken hostage after a terrorist attack.

programme.title: Deadly Inferno
programme.desc: During some extensive renovations on an eight-storey office building, a major gas leak leads to a terrible explosion, trapping the injured staff in a fiery maze. Can the brave firefighters provide a safe exit from this deadly inferno?

programme.title: Birth of the Dragon
programme.desc: In the world of martial arts, there is one man above all: Bruce Lee. San Francisco, 1965.

programme.title: Iron Fury
programme.desc: In 1944, a young lieutenant leads a courageous group of Russian soldiers in a German POW camp, plotting a daring escape from captivity in a half-dest

programme.title: Lake Placid 3
programme.desc: Monstrous crocodiles terrorize a serene country lake, leading to a bloody showdown as a wildlife scientist, local sheriff and feisty female hunter converge to take these predators down.

programme.title: Ivanhoe (1982)
programme.desc: Sir Walter Scott's epic novel of timeless romance and knightly daring comes to life! The year is 1194. At long last, the noble knight Wilfred of Ivanhoe (Anthony Andrews) has returned from the Crusades to regain his title and win the hand of his beloved Lady Rowena (Lysette Anthony).

programme.title: Black Dawn (2005)
programme.desc: CIA Agent, Jonathan Cold is working undercover to determine who are the arms dealers, who want to sell a nuclear bomb to an Eastern European terrorist group. His cover gets detected when the weapons dealers catch his former student, beautiful Amanda Hayes. Cold fights to get her out. Together they go after the bomb and find out that Hayes' boss is involved in the bombing. At the end they vanquish all there enemies and have to drop off the activated bomb over the ocean.

programme.title: Laurent de Wilde
programme.desc: Jazz à Vienne is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981, it has attracted a mix of jazz legends and exciting newcomers, with many of them playing return engagements. Each year welcomes outstanding international stars to the historical Le Théâtre Antique to impress and inspire their audiences. In 2017, French pianist Laurent de Wilde performed his tribute to jazz icon Thelonious Monk at Jazz à Vienne. Alongside bassist Jérôme Regard and drummer Donald Kontomanou, De Wilde gives a respectful and engaging homage built upon 20 years of study.

programme.title: Dizzy Gillespie, Tony Coe, Derek Humble & Billy Mitchell
programme.desc: American jazz trumpeter, composer, and bandleader Dizzy Gillespie (1917-1993) was one of the seminal figures of the bebop movement. He fuses all musical forms rooted in African culture, such as music from Cuba, Latin America and the Caribbean, into his music. On November 4, 1970 he played a concert in Denmark with the Kenny Clarke/Francy Boland Big Band, performing Con Alma, Brother K, Now Hear My Meanin', Manteca, Let Me Outta Here, and Things Are Here.

programme.title: Jimmy Smith
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Sammy Price, Doc Cheatham, J.C. Higginbotham & Elmer Crumbley
programme.sub-title: Sammy Price and his All Star Orchestra
programme.desc: Texan pianist Sammy Price (1908-1992) played everything from blues and boogie-woogie to swing and jump-blues. Starting in Dallas as a singer and dancer in Alphonso Trent's orchestra, he went to Kansas to form the Texas Bluesicians. At the end of the 1930s, and as a house pianist for the Decca label, he backed many stars, including Sister Rosetta Tharpe and Trixie Smith. Price was equally at home playing the blues in a trio, or leading a bigger band playing the jump-blues people loved to dance to. In this 1958 recording, Sammy plays the Comblain-La-Tour Jazz Festival with his band.

programme.title: Al McKay & Earth Wind & Fire Experience
programme.sub-title: Al McKay's Earth, Wind & Fire Experience
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city. One of the bands performing here in 2019 is The Earth, Wind & Fire Experience. In this concert, original Earth, Wind & Fire guitarist, writer and musical director Al McKay performs the band's timeless disco and soul. Together with seven of the thirteen original Earth, Wind & Fire members, he keep hits such as Boogie Wonderland and September alive, touring all over the world.

programme.title: Dizzy Gillespie, Tony Coe, Derek Humble & Billy Mitchell
programme.desc: American jazz trumpeter, composer, and bandleader Dizzy Gillespie (1917-1993) was one of the seminal figures of the bebop movement. He fuses all musical forms rooted in African culture, such as music from Cuba, Latin America and the Caribbean, into his music. On November 4, 1970 he played a concert in Denmark with the Kenny Clarke/Francy Boland Big Band, performing Con Alma, Brother K, Now Hear My Meanin', Manteca, Let Me Outta Here, and Things Are Here.

programme.title: Charles Bradley, William Aukstik, Frederick Deboe & Michael Deller
programme.sub-title: Charles Bradley: The Screaming Eagle Of Soul
programme.desc: This concert of soul singer Charles Bradley (1948-2017) was recorded in an intimate setting in Paris in September 2014. Before considering a career in music, Bradley had long tried to make ends meet with a series of small jobs. It was only in 1996 that he finally followed in the footsteps of his idol and soul icon James Brown, with whom he shared an exceptional ability to bring audiences to ecstasy. Bradley has developed a unique sound that combines funk, soul, and R&B, but still tinged with Brown influences.

programme.title: Red Norvo, Dave Brubeck Quartet, The Gary Burton Quartet & Dizzy Gillespie
programme.sub-title: G.B. 4, Red N., D.G. Band, D.B. 4 - Newport Jazz
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands. In 1968, jazz's greatest artists appeared at the third Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam. This broadcast features the bands of pianist Dave Brubeck, vibraphonists Gary Burton and Red Norvo, and trumpeter Dizzy Gillespie.

programme.title: Christian Zacharias, Orchestre National de Lille & Isabelle van Keulen
programme.sub-title: Schumann - Violin Concerto and Symphony No. 1
programme.desc: German conductor Christian Zacharias leads the Orchestre national de Lille in a concert program dedicated to Robert Schumann. The concert opens with the ‘Genoveva' Overture, Op. 81. Although Schumann's only opera Genoveva is not often performed, its overture established itself as an autonomous work in concert halls. After, the composer's Violin Concerto in D minor, WoO 23, is performed, featuring Dutch violinist Isabelle van Keulen as the soloist. Written in 1853, it is Schumann's only violin concerto. The concert ends with a performance of Schumann's Symphony No. 1 in B-flat major, Op. 38, also known as the ‘Spring Symphony'. This optimistic work is written in 1841 and is the most performed of Schumann's four symphonies. This concert was recorded at Auditorium du Nouveau Siècle in Lille, France, on June 16, 2017.

programme.title: National Philharmonic Orchestra of Russia, Konstantin Khvatynets & Boris Berezovsky
programme.desc: The National Philharmonic Orchestra of Russia is joined by acclaimed Russian pianist Boris Berezovsky in an interpretation of works by Rachmaninov and George Gershwin. Conductor Konstantin Khvatynets directs this concert, filmed at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow. The programme includes George Gershwin's Rhapsody in Blue and Rachmaninov's Rhapsody on a Theme by Paganini and is produced by the Moscow Philharmonic Society, which Saint Petersburg-born composer Dmitri Shostakovich himself once described as playing a significant role "in the development of musical life [in Russia]. It is a kind of university which is attended by millions of music lovers and thousands of musicians.” The Moscow Philharmonic Society was founded in 1922 by then-Commissar for Culture, Anatoly Lunacharsky, and has over the years come to be Russia's leading concert organizing institution.

programme.title: Sir Simon Rattle & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in Antonín Dvořák's spirited Slavonic Dances, Op. 46 (Nos. 1-8). These 16 folk dances earned Dvořák, who was a relative newcomer when he wrote them, great success. Originally composed for piano four hands, the London Symphony Orchestra plays the orchestral version of these brilliant works. This performance was recorded at LSO St. Luke's on Old Street in London, UK, on September 23, 2020.

programme.title: David Bateson, Tuva Semmingsen, Cassandra Lemoine & Bjørn Fjæstad
programme.sub-title: Fantasymphony – A Concert of Fire and Magic
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra once again opens the gates to magical worlds with an enchanting concert program. Under the baton of German conductor Christian Schumann, the Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Danish National Concert Choir, and Danish National Junior Choir team up to perform music from the most popular fantasy movies, TV series and video games, including The Lord of The Rings, Game of Thrones, The Hobbit, The Witcher, and League of Legends. Featured soloists in this concert are Norwegian mezzo-soprano Tuva Semmingsen, Canadian-Portuguese soprano Cassandra Lemoine, Danish musician Bjørn Fjæstad, and British actor David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in April 2023.

programme.title: David Radzynski, Franz Welser-Möst & Cleveland Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Richard Strauss - A Hero's Life, Op. 40
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst leads the Cleveland Orchestra in a concert performing Richard Strauss' Ein Heldenleben, Op. 40. Violin soloist is David Radzynski. Recorded at Severance Hall in Cleveland in February 2023. Strauss, at the age of 34, sparked outrage when he cast himself as the central figure of his tone poem. Generally agreed to be autobiographical, the work contains more than thirty quotations from Strauss's earlier works.

programme.title: AC/DC
programme.desc: Filmed at the world famous Circus Krone in Munich, this AC/DC concert from June 17, 2003 features standout performances of "Rock N Roll Damnation" and "What's Next To The Moon" and more.

programme.title: Green Day
programme.desc: Live concert of legendary punk-rock band Green Day on April 14, 2009, performing the whole of their imminent new album, "21st Century Breakdown", at the Fox Theater in the band's hometown, Oakland, California.

programme.title: The Who
programme.sub-title: Live At The Isle Of Wight Festival 2004
programme.desc: In 2004 The Who returned to the Isle Of Wight Festival for the first time since their legendary performance in 1970. After a long absence, the festival had been reborn in 2002 and continues to this day. Their UK concerts in 2004 were the first in their home country since the death of founder member John Entwistle. As the evening shadows lengthened across the festival site, The Who took to the stage and delivered an incendiary performance packed with hit singles and classic album tracks and the concert more than lived up to the fan's expectations and memories of 1970.

programme.title: La vergüenza
programme.desc: Huyendo de la guerra civil que asola su país, el matrimonio de músicos Jan y Eva Rosenberg se instala a vivir a una isla, apartados del mundo. Con humildad y sencillez viven tranquilos y felices, y solo les preocupa su arte. Pero un día la sombra de la guerra les alcanza de pleno. Llegan unos soldados y la pareja es arrestada bajo la acusación de colaborar con las fuerzas rebeldes.

programme.title: La vida de Brian
programme.desc: Brian nace en un pesebre de Belén el mismo día que Jesucristo. Un cúmulo de desgraciados y tronchantes equívocos le harán llevar una vida paralela a la del verdadero Hijo de Dios.

programme.title: ¡Agáchate, maldito!

programme.title: Doble Identidad
programme.desc: Un médico en Chechenia por motivos laborales, ve un asalto y ayuda a la joven y misteriosa víctima a huir.

programme.title: El Caso Wanninkhof: Una doble tragedia
programme.desc: Continúa el juicio contra la acusada en el caso de Rocío Wanninkhof. Gran expectación en todos los medios.

programme.title: La diligencia: La historia de Texas Jack
programme.desc: El ex ladrón de diligencias, Nathaniel Reed inicia una vida honesta junto su esposa Laura, pero no durará.

programme.title: Becky
programme.desc: Adolescente defiende su hogar de convictos.

programme.title: Cuatro Vidas
programme.desc: Según un proverbio chino, la existencia humana se divide en cuatro emociones: felicidad, placer, pena y amor.

programme.title: Ámsterdam
programme.desc: Un misterio épico sobre una sorprendente trama secreta de la historia de EE. UU.

programme.title: Aloha
programme.desc: Cameron Crowe ('Casi famosos') nos presenta la historia de un ingeniero espacial (Bradley Cooper) que regresa a su hogar. Allí acepta trabajar con una piloto (Emma Stone) que le ayudará a descubrir una mejor versión de sí mismo.

programme.title: Z. La ciudad perdida
programme.desc: Prodigio narrativo de una épica abrumadora y un sentido de la aventura vibrante y expeditivo que se erige como una expecional muestra de cine clásico contemporáneo. A principios del s.XX un explorador británico se obesiona con encontrar una antigua civilización avanzada en la selva del Amazonas.

programme.title: La Gran Apuesta
programme.desc: Basada en la historia real de 4 desconocidos que vieron lo que rechazaron los grandes bancos y el gobierno: el derrumbamiento mundial de la economía.

programme.title: Mentes Brillantes
programme.desc: Antoine para las pruebas de acceso a la carrera de Medicina… Por tercera vez! Benjamin, acaba de finalizar el bachillerato y tiene que hacer su primera elección de Carrera. Pronto se dará cuenta de que no va a ser tan fácil como suponía…

programme.title: Libertad
programme.desc: Basada en una historia real. Dos hombres separados por 100 años están unidos en su búsqueda hacia la libertad. En 1856, un esclavo, Samuel Woodward y su familia, escapan de la plantación Monroe cerca de Virginia.

programme.title: El Desprecio
programme.desc: Katie Lapp ha anhelado las cosas prohibidas, pero ¿sus sueños llegarán a un precio demasiado caro para pagar? ¿Por qué la madre de Katie, una simple mujer amish, escondería un hermoso vestido de bebé en el ático?

programme.title: Cariño, cuánto te odio
programme.desc: Rivales laborales descubren el amor.

programme.title: Me Quiere, No Me Quiere
programme.desc: Un mujeriego vuelve a casa por vacaciones y se enreda con la mujer que le rompió el corazón años atrás.

programme.title: Amor a Primera Visa
programme.desc: Tras su fiesta de despedida, despierta en el apartamento de un apuesto mariachi y padre soltero.

programme.title: Novia por conveniencia
programme.desc: Una novia rusa que quiere conseguir el permiso de residencia es encargada por correo.

programme.title: Lejos de la tierra quemada
programme.desc: Ópera prima de Guillermo Arriaga como director. Cuatro intensas historias en torno al amor.

programme.title: Love's Kitchen
programme.desc: Rob es un reconocido chef de Londres, su carrera es un éxito y la vida le sonríe hasta que un accidente acaba con la vida de su esposa. Superado por la tristeza, Rob pierde su restaurante y su interés por la cocina, hasta que animado por un grupo de amigos y su hija, decide empezar de nuevo.

programme.title: Devuélveme mi suerte
programme.desc: Ashley (Lindsay Lohan) es muy afortunada, tiene muy buena suerte y siempre le ha salido todo bien. Pero un día, Ashley besa a Jake (Chris Pine), el joven con peor suerte de la ciudad, y sus papeles se intercambian...

programme.title: Una Boda en Navidad
programme.desc: Haley Foster escapó de su pequeño pueblo de la infancia en Pineridge y construyó una gran vida en la ciudad de Los Ángeles como una de las mejores organizadoras de bodas en una empresa de élite dirigida por la Sra. Reynolds.

programme.title: Fiebre de boda
programme.desc: Dahlia Marchand, la más popular novelista romántica, le gusta ser casamentera, y está decidida a ayudar a su adorable editora a encontrar al "Señor Perfecto" para ella.

programme.title: Nuevo orden
programme.desc: Una lujosa boda de la alta sociedad se tuerce cuando una inesperada revuelta social da paso a un violento golpe de estado, visto a través de los ojos de la joven y solidaria novia y de los sirvientes que trabajan para su adinerada familia.

programme.title: Si Dios quiere
programme.desc: Tommaso, un cardiólogo de prestigio, es un hombre de firmes creencias ateas y liberales. Está casado y tiene dos hijos. Uno de ellos, Andrea, prometedor estudiante de medicina, revoluciona a la familia cuando les anuncia que quiere hacerse cura.

programme.title: Tasmania
programme.desc: En 1822, ocho convictos escapan de la brutal cárcel de Macquarie Harbour, en un intento fatídico por la libertad. Los hombres plantan cara a uno de los terrenos más inhóspitos del mundo, forzando sus condiciones humanas al límite, el inexplorado Van Diemen's Land (hoy conocida como isla de Tasmania). Mientras las provisiones se agotan y las tensiones van en aumento, el grupo pronto considera lo impensable. El hambre es un silencio extraño.

programme.title: Vete y vive
programme.desc: Gracias a una iniciativa del Estado de Israel y de los Estados Unidos, en 1985 se lleva a cabo una amplia operación para trasladar a miles de judíos etíopes (falashas) a Israel. Una mujer etíope, que no es judía, convence a su hijo para que se declare judío a fin de que pueda huir de la miseria. Cuando el niño llega a Israel, dada su condición de huérfano, lo adopta una familia judía francesa que vive en Tel-Aviv. Allí pasa la infancia atemorizado ante la posibilidad de que se descubra su doble secreto, su doble mentira: no es ni judío ni huérfano, solo es negro.

programme.title: El Turno Nocturno
programme.desc: Diego trabaja en una monótona estación de Gasolina. Situaciones desastrosas le sacan de su rutina.

programme.title: Nowhere
programme.desc: En un país latinoamericano, su dictador ha urdido un siniestro plan.

programme.title: Hojas de Hierba
programme.desc: Las vidas de dos gemelos cambian cuando el profesor de filosofía es confundido un traficante de drogas.

programme.title: Amanece en Edimburgo
programme.desc: Dos soldados regresan a su casa en Edimburgo para reanudar su vida romántica y familiar.

programme.title: Todo Me Pasa A Mí
programme.desc: El regreso de un amigo de la India hace que un grupo de jóvenes se cuestione sus relaciones.

programme.title: Asesinos internacionales
programme.desc: Roman Melnyk, jefe de construcción, y Jake Bonanos, controlador aéreo, son doscompletos desconocidos, pero sus vidas quedan fuertemente unidas después de una terrible catástrofe.

programme.title: Un hombre llamado Ove
programme.desc: Ove no es el típico vecino con el que apetece cruzarte en el barrio. Es un cascarrabias, un pesado que insiste hasta la exageración en mantener el orden y la disciplina, un casi sesentón solitario y resentido a quien el destino ha arrebatado demasiadas cosas.

programme.title: Amor y otras drogas
programme.desc: Maggie es una mujer independiente que no deja que nada le ate. Pero conoce a Jamie, cuyo encanto le sirve bien tanto con las mujeres como dentro del mundo de las farmacéuticas. La evolución que sufre su relación coge a ambos por sorpresa, al encontrarse bajo la influencia de la droga final: el amor.

programme.title: Hincame el Diente
programme.desc: ´Vampires Suck´ es una comedia sobre la ansiedad adolescente. Becca es una adolescente no vampiro que se debate entre dos chicos. Antes de que pueda elegir, Becca debe sortear a su padre.

programme.title: La hermana del novio
programme.desc: Audrey cumplirá 40 años y su hermano se casará con una chica que conoció en Francia. Antes de la boda se revela un secreto, Audrey y la joven prometida no se llevan bien.

programme.title: Ejecutivo Agresivo
programme.desc: El empresario Dave Buznik es normalmente afable y nada polémico. Pero tras un altercado a bordo de un avión, es condenado a participar en un programa de gestión de la ira. Allí descubre que su propio instructor, el Dr. Buddy Rydell, tiene un grave problema de ira, un problema que solo se revelará del todo después de que el doctor se traslade a casa de Dave para darle lecciones prácticas sobre "comportamiento calmado".

programme.title: Magnolias de Acero
programme.desc: Seis mujeres sureñas se mantienen en pie gracias a su amistad y lealtad a través de los ciclos de la vida, el matrimonio, el Nacimiento y la Muerte.

programme.title: Roxanne
programme.desc: En la pequeña ciudad turística de Nelson, Washington, el querido Jefe de bomberos C.D. Bales (Steve Martin) está acomplejado por su gran nariz. Una astrónoma, guapa e inteligente, Roxanne (Daryl Hannah), acude a la ciudad para estudiar un cometa y se siente inmediatamente atraída por otro recién llegado, el bombero profesional contratado por C.D. Chris (Rick Rossovich).

programme.title: ¿Cuándo Llegamos?
programme.desc: Nick , un joven operador está deseando conseguir pedirle una cita a una mujer atractiva, Suzanne, de la que está locamente enamorado. Después de esperar un largo tiempo parece que el momento más esperado para Nick está a punto de llegar. Suzanne se encuentra atrapada en Vancouver y necesita a alguien que pueda recoger a sus hijos y llevarles hasta ella, Nick se ofrece para ser esa persona sin dudarlo, pero lo que no sabe es que para ellos ningún hombre es lo suficientemente bueno para su madre. El viaje que Nick se imaginaba no tendrá nada que ver con el que les espera, ya que acabará siendo una pesadilla.

programme.title: La Balada de Davy Crockett
programme.desc: Mucho antes de su heroico final en El Álamo, Davy Crockett se enfrenta a la frontera salvaje para salvar a sus hijos, secuestrados por un cruel terrateniente. En su viaje, luchará contra peligros y desafíos, demostrando su valentía y amor familiar mientras desafía la injusticia en un mundo implacable.

programme.title: Cuatro pistoleros rápidos (Four Fast Guns)
programme.desc: Un pistolero llega a la ciudad de Purgatory afirmando ser el “pacificador” esperado, aunque oculta haber causado la muerte del hombre cuya misión ahora asume. A cambio de una recompensa, decide enfrentarse al jefe criminal local, un líder en silla de ruedas que envía a varios asesinos para eliminarlo.

programme.title: El día más largo de Kansas City
programme.desc: En su 21.º cumpleaños, Apanatschi hereda la mina de oro secreta de su padre. Cuando unos codiciosos buscadores descubren su existencia, planean apoderarse de ella. Obligada a pedir ayuda a Winnetou, Apanatschi se ve envuelta en una peligrosa lucha por el tesoro, mientras una banda de forajidos también entra en escena.

programme.title: Las campanas de San Angelo
programme.desc: Gridley contrabandea plata desde México usando un pasaje secreto. El guardia Roy Rogers lo descubre y envía a Lee Madison por ayuda, pero ella es capturada. Con refuerzos y la ayuda de Trigger, Roy intenta rescatarla y frenar el plan de Gridley.

programme.title: Recopilación Bonanza Episodios 28, 29, 30
programme.desc: Las aventuras del Salvaje Oeste de Ben Cartwright y sus hijos mientras dirigen y defienden su rancho de Nevada al tiempo que ayudan a la comunidad de los alrededores.

programme.title: La plegaria del vidente
programme.desc: Una prostituta estrangulada aparece en las afueras de la ciudad de Mar del Plata. Un detective, un periodista y un clarividente colaboran en una compleja investigación que desencadena otros crímenes.

programme.title: Violeta de Cobalto
programme.desc: Violeta, artista plástica atrapada en un bloqueo creativo, busca ayuda en un enigmático gurú. Lo que comienza como un intento de recuperar la inspiración la conduce a experiencias inesperadas que transformarán su visión y su arte.

programme.title: Fuera del menú
programme.desc: Un soltero de tercera generación de la gran cadena Tortilla Hut tiene que encontrar un nuevo plato para la cadena. Conoce a una guapa y magnífica chef en un restaurante de un pueblo de Nuevo México.

programme.title: Cacha de oro
programme.desc: Diego Palmiro, un legendario marchante de arte con demencia senil, se escapa de casa durante un peligroso negocio. Su hija Olga debe lidiar con el caos, gestionar a los socios y encontrar a Don Diego, quien descubre en la calle, junto al trovador Joselo, una versión peculiar de la libertad.

programme.title: Fahrenheit 11/9
programme.desc: Fahrenheit 11/9 es una mirada polémica y cómica a los tiempos que corren en EE.UU. Michael Moore retrata las elecciones presidenciales de 2016 y estos dos primeros años del mandato de Donald Trump intentando responder las dos preguntas más importantes de la era Trump: “¿Cómo demonios hemos llegado hasta aquí?” y “¿Cómo demonios salimos?”.

programme.title: Una pequeña mentira
programme.desc: Théo es un niño que vive empeñado en levantarle el ánimo a su padre, Laurent, un tipo solitario y completamente desilusionado con la vida. La oportunidad se presenta cuando Theó está a punto de ser admitido en un importante club de fútbol inglés, pero debido a su pequeña estatura es finalmente rechazado. Para no darle una mala noticia a su padre, Théo no se atreve a confesárselo, lo que da pie a una pequeña mentira que muy pronto le vendrá muy grande.

programme.title: The winter lake
programme.desc: Después de hacer un descubrimiento sombrío en un lago estacional, un adolescente retraído descubre la verdad sobre sus vecinos, un padre y una hija que albergan secretos siniestros.

programme.title: Éternité
programme.desc: A finales del siglo XIX, Valentine, de 20 años, se casa con Jules. Cien años más tarde, su nieta recorre un puente en París para encontrarse con el hombre que ama. Durante el siglo que las separa, hombres y mujeres se conocen, se enamoran y cruzan sus destinos, creando un árbol genealógico y una fuerza vital que continuará para la eternidad…

programme.title: El sueño de Valentín
programme.desc: 1960, Buenos Aires. Valentín es un niño de nueve años que vive con su abuela. Su madre desapareció cuando él tenía tres años y su padre es un hombre descontrolado e incapaz de asumir responsabilidades. Valentín es un niño solitario que busca constantemente amor y cariño.

programme.title: El apóstata
programme.desc: Premio FIPRESCI del Festival de San Sebastián 2015. "El apóstata" es una comedia dramática que repasa las cicatrices de un joven que desea emanciparse de aquello que se escapa de su control, a la vez que dispara contra sí mismo y con un afán cínico en algunas cuestiones de fe, de culpa y de deseo.

programme.title: Quién eres
programme.desc: Esta película cuenta la historia de María, una joven que busca formar parte de un grupo y que es bastante ingenua. Después de una gran discusión con su amiga Clara, decide pasar el rato hablando con Lucas, un hombre que ha conocido a través de internet y del que sabe más bien poco.

programme.title: Frontera
programme.desc: Un grupo de teatro ensaya una versión de 12 hombres sin piedad cuando los interrumpe una alarma. Nos encontramos dentro de la prisión de Quatre Camins y la señal indica el aislamiento de los módulo.

programme.title: Negociador
programme.desc: Comedia basada en las negociaciones entre el presidente del PSE vasco, Jesús Eguiguren y ETA en 2005 y 2006.

programme.title: The Brain That Wouldn't Die
programme.desc: A doctor experimenting with transplant techniques keeps his girlfriend's head alive when she is decapitated in a car crash, then goes hunting for a new body.

programme.desc: ¿Es posible viajar en el tiempo para evitar una catástrofe? El capitán Colter Stevens (Jake Gyllenhaal) tiene la difícil misión de conseguirlo en esta eficaz película de acción y ciencia-ficción considerada como una de las mejores películas del género de los últimos años.

programme.title: Britannic
programme.desc: Un relato ficticio del hundimiento del H.M.H.S. Britannic frente a la isla griega de Kea en noviembre de 1916. Explora la teoría de un agente alemán saboteando el transatlántico, un barco hospital.

programme.desc: En la II GM, el teniente Robert Cappa y su pelotón defienden una posición vital del último ataque nazi.

programme.title: Soldado de Fortuna
programme.desc: Un antiguo miembro de los Boinas Verdes debe llevar a cabo una misión cerca de la frontera de Afganistán.

programme.title: Terms & Conditions
programme.desc: El asesino a sueldo Vet Jones recibe un ultimátum de su antiguo jefe: mata al objetivo o muere su hijo.

programme.title: Breakout

programme.title: El Sicario de Dios
programme.desc: En un mundo post-apocalíptico, una guerra encarnizada entre hombres y vampiros se ha prolongado durante siglos. Un sacerdote renegado luchará por salvar a su sobrina de la garras de los vampiros que desean convertirla en una de ellos. Para salvarla, este sacerdote guerrero tendrá que romper su juramento de paz, y darle caza al enjambre antes de que sea demasiado tarde.

programme.title: Seguridad Nacional
programme.desc: Martin Lawrence protagoniza esta comedia divertida y llena de acción interpretando a Earl Montgomery, un cadete del Departamento de Policía de Los Ángeles algo gallito que probablemente sería un policía extraordinario si no fuera tan fanfarrón. La rebelde actitud de Earl hace que le echen de la academia de policía y tiene que aceptar un empleo como humilde guarda de seguridad en “National Security.

programme.desc: Basada en las memorias escritas por Philippe Petit (Joseph Gordon-Levitt), un funambulista francés que, en 1974, guiado por su mentor Papa Rudy (Ben Kingsley), se propuso un reto nunca antes realizado: recorrer sobre un cable el espacio que separaba las Torres Gemelas de Nueva York.
